title: Parts Pick Ticket
description: The internal slip generated for a repair order telling the parts department which parts to physically pull and stage for the tech.
x-sap-analogue: Reservation / goods issue slip (MB1A-style) against the internal order
x-api-note: Referenced as a workflow step tied to RO parts lines in the materials/cost-object documentation; no standalone Fortellis pick-ticket API schema was found separate from the RO parts array.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.
